page: Microsoft Azure E32ps_v6 is an ARM-based, memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Epsv6 server family. It runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor and is powered by a Microsoft Neoverse-N2 ARM processor. The server features 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs operating at 3.4 GHz, with a single thread per core. Cache configuration includes 64 KB of L1d cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 128 MB of L3 cache. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or onboard GPUs, but it is Premium Storage capable.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core and memory subsystem performance. The E32ps_v6 achieves top-tier ratings in memory bandwidth for both large-block read-only and write operations, alongside a top-tier PassMark memory score. Multi-core compute performance is strong, as demonstrated by stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. However, single-core performance is average across stress-ng, Geekbench, and bzip3 tests. Large-scale LLM inference reveals a performance tradeoff, with prompt processing for a 70B model falling into the bottom tier, though text generation for the same model remains average.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the E32ps_v6 offers high memory density and strong memory bandwidth per resource, making it a viable option for memory-bound workloads that do not require local NVMe storage. The server is suited for database operations, as evidenced by its top-tier PassMark database operations benchmark. Other appropriate workloads include static web serving, software compilation, and memory-intensive general-purpose applications that benefit from dedicated ARM physical cores and high memory throughput.
description: Microsoft Azure E32ps_v6 is an ARM-based, memory-optimized virtual machine powered by a 3.4 GHz Microsoft Neoverse-N2 processor with 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs. It features 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core, though it lacks local storage and onboard GPUs. Running on Microsoft Hyper-V, the server exhibits top-tier memory bandwidth, with large-block read speeds of 436.06 GB/sec and write speeds of 184.19 GB/sec. While single-core benchmarks and large-model LLM prompt processing show average to poor performance, its multi-core capabilities and database operations benchmarks are strong to top-tier. This hardware profile makes the E32ps_v6 highly suitable for memory-intensive workloads, database operations, software compilation, and static web serving.
